sqlMap.select: SELECT AP_TYPE , AP_NO , AP_RESULT , AP_NOTE , AP_DATE , IF_FLAG , IF_DATE FROM KEP_APIF_LOTTECS@KEPLINK WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND SUBSTR(AP_NO,1,2) NOT IN ('G2','Q2')
sqlMap.update: UPDATE KEP_APIF_LOTTECS@KEPLINK SET IF_FLAG = #IF_FLAG# , IF_DATE = SYSDATE , IF_MSG = #IF_MSG# WHERE AP_NO = #AP_NO# AND AP_TYPE = #AP_TYPE#
